title: Franklin Templeton, Binance allow tokenized MMFs as off-exchange collateral
summary: Franklin Templeton is letting institutions pledge tokenized money market fund shares as collateral for trading on Binance, while keeping the fund assets in off‑exchange custody.

title: Spark’s new lending suite tests institutional appetite for onchain stablecoins
summary: Spark is rolling out Spark Prime and Spark Institutional Lending, aiming to turn its DeFi stablecoin stack into institutional margin and credit lines.

title: Bitcoin price drops 3% as analyst warns bulls lack 'momentum' to flip $69K
summary: Bitcoin analysis warned the $69,000 mark may end up as long-term resistance again, thanks to its significance in BTC price history.

title: Crypto super PAC to spend $5M on Barry Moore’s Senate bid: Report
summary: Crypto political action committee Fairshake spent roughly $130 million during the 2024 US elections to support pro-crypto candidates.

title: White House crypto bill talks ‘productive,’ but no deal yet
summary: The second meeting between crypto and the banks at the White House over the crypto market structure bill has yet to come to an agreement on stablecoin provisions.

title: Crypto’s ‘age of speculation’ may be ending: Galaxy’s Novogratz
summary: Galaxy CEO Mike Novogratz says crypto's high-risk, high-reward reputation could be replaced by lower, steadier returns brought by real-world asset tokenization.

title: Tokenized commodities market crosses $6B amid gold’s historic rally
summary: Tether Gold and the Paxos-issued PAX Gold account for over 95% of the tokenized commodities market, which is now outpacing tokenized stocks and funds.

title: Robinhood Q4 earnings miss as crypto revenues decline
summary: Robinhood shares fell nearly 8% in after-hours trading as the platform’s record Q4 revenues weren’t enough to satisfy analysts’ predictions.

title: LayerZero unveils ‘Zero’ chain with Citadel Securities, ARK Invest backing
summary: Zero is scheduled to launch fall 2026 and LayerZero Labs claims it can scale up to two million transactions per second by leveraging zero-knowledge proofs and Jolt.

title: Ex-SafeMoon chief sentenced to more than 8 years over $9M investor fraud
summary: SafeMoon’s former chief technology officer, Thomas Smith, has also pleaded guilty and is awaiting sentencing. Alleged co-conspirator Kyle Nagy remains at large.
